const express=require('express');const OpenAI=require('OpenAI');const fs=require('node:fs');const{WebSocketServer}=require('ws');//const webserver = express().listen(3000, () => console.log(`Listening on ${3000}`));
const openai=new OpenAI({apiKey:process.env.APIKEY});const openaiprompt=fs.readFileSync('./prompt/'+process.env.PROMPT_FILE_NAME,'utf8');const sockserver=new WebSocketServer({port:3001},()=>console.log("Listening on ".concat(3001)));sockserver.on('connection',ws=>{ws.on('message',async message=>{const MSG=JSON.parse(message);if(MSG.type==='prompt'){console.log("A---"+MSG.voicePrompt);const response=await openai.chat.completions.create({model:'chatgpt-4o-latest',messages:[{role:'system',content:openaiprompt},{role:'user',content:MSG.voicePrompt}]});const reply=response.choices[0].message.content;ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:"text",token:reply,last:true}));console.log("B---"+reply);}});ws.on('close',()=>console.log('Client has disconnected!'));ws.onerror=function(){console.log('websocket error');};});
